relative_lift.question: Express the lift relative to control.
relative_lift.reference:
rates = df.groupby("con_treat")["converted"].agg(["sum", "count", "mean"])
print(rates)


c0, n0 = 17723, 147202
c1, n1 = 17514, 147276
p0, p1 = c0/n0, c1/n1
p = (c0+c1)/(n0+n1)
se = math.sqrt(p*(1-p)*(1/n0 + 1/n1))
z = (p1-p0)/se
pv = 2*(1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))
print(f"z={z:.4f} p={pv:.4f}")
print("significant?", pv < 0.05)  # False


mde = (1.959964 + 0.841621) * se
print(f"MDE={mde:.6f} ({mde/p0*100:.2f}% of control)")


rel = round((p1 - p0) / p0, 4)
print(rel)

ci_low.question: Confirm the observed diff lies inside the 95 percent CI.
ci_low.reference:
# --- Solution 1 ---
rates = df.groupby("con_treat")["converted"].agg(["sum", "count", "mean"])
print(rates)

# --- Solution 2 ---
c0, n0 = 17723, 147202
c1, n1 = 17514, 147276
p0, p1 = c0/n0, c1/n1
p = (c0+c1)/(n0+n1)
se = math.sqrt(p*(1-p)*(1/n0 + 1/n1))
z = (p1-p0)/se
pv = 2*(1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))
print(f"z={z:.4f} p={pv:.4f}")
print("significant?", pv < 0.05)  # False

# --- Solution 3 ---
mde = (1.959964 + 0.841621) * se
print(f"MDE={mde:.6f} ({mde/p0*100:.2f}% of control)")

# --- Follow-up 1 ---
rel = round((p1 - p0) / p0, 4)
print(rel)

# --- Follow-up 2 ---
se_u = math.sqrt(p0 * (1 - p0) / n0 + p1 * (1 - p1) / n1)
lo, hi = (p1 - p0) - 1.96 * se_u, (p1 - p0) + 1.96 * se_u
print(round(lo, 6), round(hi, 6))

# --- Follow-up 3 ---
print(abs(p1 - p0) < mde)  # True -> underpowered for this effect
